summary: Frontend-only regression pass for BIOTECH LIFESCIENCES after logo/DNA/GoalsStrip/StackBuilder/Researcher/FreeBACWater bug-fix batch. All 15 review-request items verified on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 14/15 fully pass; 1 minor UX gap noted (variant selection on PDP does not change price because the product model exposes a single price).

integration_issues.issue: Selecting a different size variant on /products/:slug updates the .selected button state but the displayed price stays at p.price (₹4,999.00 for retatrutide across 10mg/20mg/30mg). Review request expected variant selection to change price — data model has only one price per product, so this is a data/model gap, not a rendering bug. Consider variant-level pricing.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If variant-level pricing is desired, add per-variant price map and update .price.big strong on variant change. Otherwise remove the review-request expectation.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is minified onto ~10 lines (~119 line file but each line has multiple concerns crammed together) — very hard to maintain/debug. Recommend splitting into modules (components/, data/, hooks/) with normal formatting.

ScientificVisual renders a single WebGL frame in useEffect (renderer.render called once) then returns cleanup — correct for the intended static DNA visual (no rotation loop, verified by canvas dataURL being byte-identical at t0 and t+1.2s).

Goal-based product filtering with p.goals.includes(slug) works but the guide/collection detail pages don't handle unknown slugs gracefully in <Collections/> route (only /collections/:slug does via GoalDetail fallback to ProductsPage).
Product has a single `price` — variant switching only updates local state without any price/COA/stock delta. Consider adding variantPricing map keyed by variant string.
Wishlist and cart use localStorage without a schema version — future data-shape changes will crash existing users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows pass, 1 minor UX gap

seed_data_creation: None. localStorage keys biotech-age, biotech-cart, biotech-wishlist were exercised during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) age-gate persists via biotech-age localStorage (2) brand-logo contains only , no wordmark text (3) hero DNA canvas renders once and is static (dataURL identical over time) (4) announcement bar + trust bar (6 items) both include FREE BAC WATER (5) GoalsStrip has 9 correct slugs and navigates to /collections/:slug which renders goal-hero- (6) 9 Shop-by-Goal cards on Home (7) 7 StackBuilder tabs (wolverine, glow, klow, gh-classic, cutting, longevity, cognitive) — tab switching updates stack-card-, ADD ALL TO CART adds correct items and opens drawer (verified cutting -> retatrutide + aod-9604) (8) Researcher section visible with unsplash lab image (9) /guide renders 9 blocks with 56 rows all linking to product detail (10) /products/retatrutide shows deep-dive-section + uses-section, request-coa-button opens coa-modal with valid mailto: and https://wa.me/ links (11) Search overlay filters correctly, ADD TO CART increments cart-count, wishlist heart persists on reload (['cjc-1295-with-dac'] in localStorage after reload) (12) /cart, /checkout render form (13) Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth=390), goals-strip has overflow-x:auto with scrollWidth=1528px enabling horizontal scroll, mobile-menu-button opens mobile-menu with 11 links. No console errors — only benign 'No routes matched location' warnings from Playwright's initial goto before hydration, and one non-fatal GL_CLOSE_PATH_NV performance warning.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions. The only observation (variant does not change price on PDP) is a data-model limitation, not a bug introduced by the recent fixes.
